title: The Smiling Winter
author: R. M. Coldharbour
blurb: Orsen Delacroix, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
